resources.string: Local GGUF models · open / restore llama.cpp
Independent per-assistant tool. Install Qwen3-VL and its projector under Local GGUF models. Loads on demand and releases after each call; automatic OCR is configured separately.

Use the installed local visual model instead of a provider OCR model. Only runs when automatic image processing needs OCR; off by default. Download both weights and projector first. Failure preserves the original image; there is no cloud OCR fallback. The original image may still be sent to the main chat model.

Automatic OCR extracts text when sending images. The offline image / video tool is separate and controlled per assistant; enabling either does not enable the other. Video uses sparse keyframes up to 60 seconds, without audio.
